modules.title: 页面现象应该对应哪个证据面板
四个常用面板分别回答什么

items.title: 怎样打开开发者工具
items.text: 右键单击并选择“检查”或“审查元素”。快捷键：Mac 为 Cmd+Option+I，Windows 为 F12 或 Ctrl+Shift+I。默认打开 Elements 面板，点击标签页可切换至 Console、Network 或 Application 面板。

items.title: Elements 和 Console
items.text: Elements 检查当前 DOM、属性和 CSS；Console 显示脚本报错、日志以及可以复现的运行时信息。

items.title: Network 和 Storage
items.text: Network 检查请求、状态码、请求与响应；Storage 检查 Cookie、Web Storage 等浏览器保存的状态。先按现象选面板，再把证据带回修改和复测。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: DevTools 是观察和定位问题的工具，不是自动修复按钮。它不能代替服务端日志、数据库记录或后端权限判断；面板里的临时改动也不等于已经修改项目文件。

lessonPractice.title: 保存按钮点击后没有更新，页面提示需要看服务器返回的失败原因。先打开哪个面板？

options.label: 打开 Network，查看保存请求的状态码、请求内容和响应
options.feedback: 对。服务器返回的状态和响应内容属于网络请求证据，Network 能把失败停在哪一步显示出来。

options.label: 打开 Elements，反复修改按钮文字直到页面看起来像保存成功
options.feedback: Elements 适合检查节点和样式，改文字不能证明请求成功，也看不到服务器返回的原因。

options.label: 打开 Storage，先删除所有浏览器数据再重新点击保存
options.feedback: 清除存储可能丢失登录态和草稿，却不能直接说明这次请求为何失败；应先保留并查看请求证据。

en.title: Clicking Save does not update the page, and the server response is needed to explain the failure. Which panel should you open first?

options.label: Open Network and inspect the save request's status, payload, and response
options.feedback: Correct. The server status and response are network evidence, and Network shows where the save flow stopped.

options.label: Open Elements and keep changing the button text until it looks saved
options.feedback: Elements is for nodes and styles. Changing text cannot prove the request succeeded or reveal the server's reason.

options.label: Open Storage, delete all browser data, and click Save again
options.feedback: Clearing storage may lose a session or draft without explaining this failure. Preserve and inspect the request evidence first.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请用浏览器开发者工具排查保存失败：说明你在 Elements、Console、Network 或 Storage 中分别看到了什么，重点记录保存请求的状态码和响应内容。找到证据后再修改代码，并重新发送一次请求确认页面更新。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Use the browser developer tools to investigate the failed save. State what you found in Elements, Console, Network, or Storage, especially the save request's status and response. Modify the code only after finding evidence, then send the request again and confirm the page updates.

references.title: 什么是浏览器开发者工具

learning.assumes: You have opened a web page and encountered a display problem, an unresponsive action, or a failed request.
learning.outcome: You can choose Elements, Console, Network, or Storage from the visible symptom, record evidence, and describe the issue to an AI Agent.

modules.title: Which evidence panel matches a page symptom
What the four common panels answer

items.title: How to open DevTools
items.text: Right-click and select 'Inspect' or 'Inspect Element'. Shortcuts: Mac Cmd+Option+I, Windows F12 or Ctrl+Shift+I. Opens to Elements panel by default, click tabs to switch to Console, Network, or Application.

items.title: Elements and Console
items.text: Elements inspects the current DOM, attributes, and CSS; Console shows script errors, logs, and reproducible runtime information.

items.title: Network and Storage
items.text: Network inspects requests, status codes, request data, and responses; Storage inspects browser state such as cookies and Web Storage. Choose by symptom, then carry evidence into the fix and retest.

modules.title: What it is not
modules.text: DevTools is for observing and locating problems, not an automatic repair button. It cannot replace server logs, database records, or backend authorization checks; a temporary edit in a panel is not a change to the project files.

distinctions.label: Terminal
distinctions.text: {c:browser-devtools} inspects a page from inside the browser; {c:terminal} runs commands and tools in the development environment.

distinctions.label: Server log
distinctions.text: {c:browser-devtools} shows what the browser can observe; {c:server-log} records events inside the server and can explain failures the browser cannot see.
